title: ER-Chord: Spatially Consistent One-Step Image Editing via Equal-Energy Reliability Redistribution
title_zh: ER-Chord：通过等能可靠性重分配实现空间一致的单步图像编辑

paragraphs.en: 提出免训练免反演的ER-Chord框架，通过等能可靠性重分配实现空间一致的单步图像编辑。 One-step generative models enable fast text-guided image editing, yet they often introduce unintended changes to regions that should remain unchanged. Temporal aggregation stabilizes editing fields across noise levels, but leaves their spatial allocation insensitive to local variations in reliability. Consequently, temporal stability alone does not ensure spatially consistent editing. To address this lim- itation, we propose ER-Chord, a training-free and inversion-free framework for reliability-guided spatial redistribution. Our key insight is that agreement between editing fields at neighboring noise levels provides a local reliability signal for allocating editing strength. We formulate this allocation as an equal-energy op- timization that redistributes control energy according to local reliability while preserving the original editing directions and total control energy. This formu- lation admits a unique global solution that can be efficiently computed using existing field evaluations, requiring no additional denoiser calls. Experiments on two benchmarks, PIE-Bench and TEdBench, demonstrate improvements over state-of-the-art one-step editing baselines, achieving superior source preservation alongside consistent gains across multiple generative backbones.The project page is at https://github.com/Peizeli1/ER-Chord.
paragraphs.zh: 提出免训练免反演的ER-Chord框架，通过等能可靠性重分配实现空间一致的单步图像编辑。单步生成模型能够实现快速的文本引导图像编辑，但它们常常会对本应保持不变的区域引入意外的更改。 时间聚合能在不同噪声水平间稳定编辑场，但使其空间分配对局部可靠性变化不敏感。 因此，仅凭时间稳定性并不能确保空间一致的编辑。 为解决这一局限，我们提出ER-Chord，一个免训练免反演的可靠性引导空间重分配框架。 我们的关键洞察是：相邻噪声水平下编辑场之间的一致性可以作为分配编辑强度的局部可靠性信号。 我们将这种分配表述为一个等能优化问题，在保持原始编辑方向和总控制能量的同时，根据局部可靠性重新分配控制能量。 该表述存在唯一的全局解，可以利用现有的场评估高效计算，无需额外的去噪器调用。 在PIE-Bench和TEdBench两个基准上的实验表明，我们的方法优于最先进的单步编辑基线，在多个生成主干上取得一致的增益，同时实现更优的源图像保持。项目页面见 https://github.com/Peizeli1/ER-Chord。
